Note.title: Note
Note.description: A color-coded text note or interactive checklist belonging to a user.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the note owner.

type.description: Whether the note is freeform text or an interactive checklist.

items.description: Checklist items for checklist notes (max 200 items).

isPinned.description: Whether the note is pinned to the top.

isTrashed.description: Whether the note is in the recycle bin.

isLocked.description: Whether the note requires the master password to view or edit.

isWidget.description: Whether the note is pinned to the Home Screen Widget dock.

reminderAt.description: Optional ISO-8601 reminder date/time string or empty string.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the note was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the note was last modified.

BackupSnapshot.title: BackupSnapshot
BackupSnapshot.description: Automated or manual cloud backup snapshot of a user's notes.

id.description: Unique identifier for the backup snapshot.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the snapshot owner.

trigger.description: Whether the snapshot was triggered manually or automatically.

noteCount.description: Number of notes captured in this backup snapshot.

notes.description: Array of serialized note snapshot objects (max 300).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the backup was created.

UserPreferences.title: UserPreferences
UserPreferences.description: Per-user workspace preferences, theme, auto-backup schedule, and salted master lock hash.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the settings owner.

defaultColor.description: Default color for newly created notes.

lastAutoBackupAt.description: ISO timestamp of the most recent automated backup.

lockHash.description: SHA-256 hex digest of salted master password, or empty string when disabled.

lockSalt.description: Random hex salt for master password verification, or empty string when disabled.

autoLockMinutes.description: Minutes before locked notes automatically re-lock (0 = immediate/manual).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when preferences were last updated.

/users/{userId}/notes/{noteId}.description: User-owned color notes and checklists synced across devices.

/users/{userId}/backups/{backupId}.description: User-owned automated and manual cloud backup snapshots.

/users/{userId}/settings/{settingId}.description: User-owned workspace preferences and salted master lock hash.
